name: xbow
cmd:
O=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/xbow; mkdir -p $O/hi $O/final
python3 sculpt_char.py --character crossbowman --fine --out $O/hi/crossbowman_hi.blend --shots $O/hi/shots_fine > $O/char.log 2>&1 & CP=$!
python3 sculpt_base.py --module crossbowman_base --fine --out $O/hi/crossbowman_base_hi.blend --shots $O/hi/base_shots_fine > $O/base.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/base.log; exit 1)
wait $CP || (tail -40 $O/char.log; exit 1)
python3 build_game.py -- --character crossbowman --char $O/hi/crossbowman_hi.blend --base $O/hi/crossbowman_base_hi.blend --out $O/final --tex 2048 --ao 40 > $O/bake.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/bake.log; exit 1)
ls -la $O/final; rm -f $O/hi/*.blend
